rationale: User ruling 2026-09-18: put the tiebreak lane (秤砣线) live and pause every other strategy -- closed, not deleted. A paused lane still compiles, records its decisions and writes the evidence the ledger and the fits read; only its sends are held (basket BUYs end failed with strategy_lane_paused:basket on their event; the two sell lanes are skipped by the daemon). Read fresh before every send. Missing file = every lane enabled; unreadable file = every lane paused. Charters 146, 163 and 166.

basket.note: Every BUY the basket compile mints: seat, top-up, charter 143 completion, charter 145 TAF entry.

certain_win_recycle.note: Charter 100: a resting GTC limit sell at 0.99 on every held leg of a market still trading, for the shares not already offered or sold, not post-only; a standing bid at or above 0.99 fills it at once (user rulings 2026-09-18: 「直接挂单卖出啊，和收盘没关系吧」「一直挂」「改为0.99」). A resting recycle sell neither freezes its station-day's quotes nor shuts its token to the next order. At most 8 sends a cycle, highest bid first. Reopened 2026-09-18 08:50Z (「继续，打开车道」).

mis_bought_leg_exit.note: Charter 144: the sell-back of legs bought outside the completion rule.

tiebreak.note: 秤砣线 v2.2 (charter 163, user ruling 2026-09-20 「秤砣线从吃单改为post only，挂best买一+1」): at a stage's first decision, the model's mode bucket priced 0.40-0.60 by the market's normalised mid AND quoted both sides at most 3 cents wide -> rest one post-only GTD rung on that bucket at the best bid plus one tick (clamped under the ask), stake_usdc' worth of shares, once per station-day.  The same four conditions as v2.1, which crossed at the walked ask from 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-20; the rule version is separate so the two are not averaged together.  Features (market move since the previous decision, spread, depth) are recorded on every evaluation row, not traded on.  v2.1 / v2 / v1 selectable by rule.  A send the VENUE turned away because the market was not trading ("trading is disabled") spends none of max_sends_per_station_day: it is the venue's own state, not a verdict on the book, and a market shut at 17:37Z is usually open later the same day.  Counted, it ended NZWN 2026-09-21 and MMMX 2026-09-20 in six and thirteen minutes on 2026-09-19.  Those attempts have their own budget and an hour between tries (user ruling 2026-09-20 「改」).

p1_tail.note: P1 尾段线 v1 (charter 166, user ruling 2026-09-20 「上线尾段车道 p1_tail 策略」): on a P1 envelope whose own likelihood receipt puts the report 6 to 10 hours from this station's settlement clock, the belief is the market's normalised mid ladder masked by the hard observed bound and multiplied by that envelope's served observation likelihood; where that belief clears the best ask by 8 cents the lane crosses FOK for stake_usdc' worth, one bucket once ever, at most max_sends_per_station_day a day. Measured 2026-09-20 over 09-05..09-19: +0.166 per dollar at the report plus two minutes, +0.138 at five, +0.077 at eight with a lower bound through zero; outside the bin negative or absent. The bin was chosen after seeing the result and only 09-18/19 are days no selection saw, so the lane ships at 5 USDC and keeps every evaluation. A take is priced on the newest snapshot and arrives later, so book_fresh_seconds bounds what may be SCORED and send_book_fresh_seconds (60s) what may be BOUGHT, and a take never asks for the whole top level. The limit may walk walk_ticks above the best ask (the top level is too thin to fill a 5 USDC take most of the time), and the hurdle is then tested against that walked price rather than the ask. Conflicts with the tiebreak lane: never the same bucket, never queued behind a resting BUY of any lane, separate evaluation table and intent prefix.
